gate_provenance.Q0: docs/43 §3-A.5 — the reference must be the state it claims to be
gate_provenance.Q1: docs/43 §3 'Method': conv_thr = 1e-10. Enforced as: a '!' total energy, a printed 'convergence has been achieved', and a final estimated scf accuracy <= conv_thr. 'JOB DONE' is explicitly not accepted (lessons.md, three incidents). Since docs/43 am.4 §7 item 3 it also demands a USABLE force block on every deck that feeds H (the reference and every displacement except the ym controls): a missing or truncated block is a hard gate failure (VOID), never a silent coordinate drop — the N38 rule, missing evidence must not score as a pass.
gate_provenance.Q2: docs/43 §3 'Method': nosym/noinv on EVERY displacement including the reference, and an identical k-point set throughout.
gate_provenance.Q3: docs/43 §3 'Magnetic guard', tolerance 0.1 mu_B, >2 exclusions of 18 voids.
gate_provenance.Q4: Q4a: docs/43 §3-A.4 — the Hessian-symmetry gate, made absolute. Q4b: CODE-LEVEL, in no docs/43 clause (findings N32/N33): per-ROW mean asymmetry against an absolute floor 3*sqrt(2)*sigma_F_design/delta — reported, not registered. The old same-sample max/rms ratio is demoted to a diagnostic.
gate_provenance.Q5: docs/43 §3 'Method' registered this check; docs/43 amendment 3 and am.4 §7 item 4 DEMOTE it to REPORTED, NOT GATED: the y/xz cross elements are structurally zero by the same mirror that makes each ym deck the exact image of its yp partner, so the check is a noise measurement, not a physics gate. The measurement stays in the output; it can no longer fail a state.
gate_provenance.Q6: CODE-LEVEL, in no docs/43 clause (finding N34) — reported, not registered. docs/43 amendment 3 establishes the identity: each ym deck is the EXACT mirror of its yp partner and pw.x is deterministic, so F_y(ym) = -F_y(yp) and F_x/F_z(ym) = +F_x/F_z(yp) atom by atom, and every +/-x, +/-z deck of a mirror-symmetric reference is its own mirror (F_y = 0 on the on-plane atoms). Checked on the RAW force blocks with a tolerance derived from the design sigma_F. This is the ONLY available test of the Hessian DIAGONAL: an error confined to the displaced coordinate's own force component is invisible to Q4's off-diagonal asymmetry and to the measured sigma_F, yet it sets the sign of the curvature and therefore the verdict.

results.reason: gates passed, but the effective floor on the y-character modes reaches i265 cm^-1 (mode #0, f_y=1.000, atom weights ['0.11', '0.11', '0.78']), above the declared i80 cm^-1. The out-of-plane modes of *OOH are H-dominated and the floor is mass dependent, so this run could not have resolved the mode it exists to detect. **Blindness is not a null (docs/43 §3-A.3).** BE CLEAR ABOUT WHAT THIS MEANS FOR REFUTED (U12): at the design sigma_F = 1e-05 Ry/bohr the y floor exceeds i80 cm^-1 by construction (~i111 on an H-carried mode), so REFUTED — the only verdict that can trigger §3's R3 branch — is UNREACHABLE at the design settings and a gate-clean all-real spectrum lands here instead. The registered response, and the only registered route to a REFUTED, is docs/43 amendment 2's escalation: rerun at delta = 0.02 A. A tighter conv_thr is NOT the response — amendment 2 measured ethr = 1.79e-13 at conv_thr = 1e-10, already against QE's MAX(ethr, 1e-13) clamp, so 1e-12 returns 'convergence NOT achieved', a VOID, not a tighter measurement.
